progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: C1: equal nonzero opposing rates, rate versus amount, closed model.
progression.startsWith: A-only reversible reaction model before equilibrium.
progression.stopsAfter: Explain how changing amounts bring rates towards equality; distinguish rate/concentration plots. No catalysts or collision tutorial.

teaching.task: How opposing reaction rates come to match
teaching.causalExplanation: Less starting A slows forward; accumulating B speeds reverse in declared model. Net direction uses both rates.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Explain cause before term, speak current graph relationship rather than read every label.
teaching.openingDecision: Rhetorical question, answered with staged physical/model graph change. Independent thinking protected later.
teaching.understandingCheck: New-case attempt with complete conditions and demands, 15-second answer-free interval, staged feedback. Re-record prompt and feedback separately.
